name: The AI App Builder Database
description: An AI app builder turns an idea into screens: a home screen, a list and a detail screen, with buttons and a cart. The demo on this page is a LOCAL DEMO ONLY: it is rule-based, follows 5 written rules, makes 0 real AI calls, and hosted AI is BLOCKED. A real AI app builder needs a hosted backend, and this page honestly says so. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
